description.value: Buhlman Road Park Reserve is a nature reserve near Sidney, BC, managed by the Capital Regional District. It appears to correspond to the CRD's Bulman Trail, a natural-surface trail in the Greater Victoria region. Touring cyclists exploring the Saanich Peninsula may use it as a short off-road detour through protected green space.

address.value: Bulman Road (access across from 211 Bulman Rd), Salt Spring Island, BC V8K 1X5
